milestones.title: Deep crawl: async Apify job up to 100 pages per vendor
milestones.proof_description: Replace the synchronous n8n WCC webhook call (max 3 pages, 100s Cloudflare limit) with a direct async Apify job. The enrichment pipeline must: (1) submit a crawl job to Apify Website Content Crawler via the Apify REST API with max_pages=100, (2) poll for completion (job typically takes 2–10 minutes), (3) retrieve and concatenate all page text into a single raw blob, (4) store the blob in a new raw_crawl_blob field or chunked in raw_description. The n8n webhook path remains as a fast fallback for vendors where deep crawl is not yet available. Prove by crawling 3 vendors to 100 pages and asserting the blob is stored in Supabase.

schema_additions.raw_crawl_blob: text — full concatenated page text from deep crawl (up to 100 pages)
schema_additions.crawl_completed_at: timestamp — when deep crawl last ran

milestones.proof_description: n8n workflow for pricing enrichment. Stage 1: crawl /pricing page with content-quality gate (min 200 visible-text words). Stage 2 fallback: LLM prompt with nullable tier fields, additionalProperties false, no URL citation required. Output: pricing array, has_public_pricing_page bool, free_trial bool, pricing_source scraped or llm_inferred. Writes via M64 validation endpoint. Tested on 10 vendors (5 with known public pricing, 5 without). LLM-inferred pricing shown on public site with llm_inferred label.

milestones.title: Tracxn teaser enrichment: founded, hq_address, funding_stage via teaser page scrape
milestones.proof_description: Enrichment pipeline crawls tracxn.com/d/companies/{slug}/ teaser for each vendor. Extracts founded, hq_address, funding_stage, total_funding. Safe-upsert mode: only writes to null or empty fields, never overwrites operator-set values. Canary check on one known-good Tracxn URL before each batch; abort if canary fails. Miss-rate logged per run.

milestones.title: Trustpilot rating enrichment via static HTML crawl
milestones.proof_description: Plain HTTP GET of trustpilot.com/review/{slug} extracts AggregateRating JSON-LD block. Populates trustpilot_rating (float) and trustpilot_review_count (int) for vendors with a Trustpilot presence. n8n workflow csp-trustpilot-enrichment deployed to n8n cloud. Run against 10 vendors, show at least 3 hits with valid rating values written to Supabase via /admin/enrich-write.

milestones.notes: Trustpilot serves fully static HTML with schema.org AggregateRating JSON-LD — no Cloudflare, no JS execution needed. milestones.title: Internal feature-depth score from vendor help/docs site crawl
milestones.proof_description: Crawl each vendor's help_center_url (or developer_docs_url fallback) via Framework Website Content Crawl. LLM extracts structured feature taxonomy across 6 dimensions. feature_depth_score (0-100, category-relative) and feature_signals (list of detected capabilities) computed and written to Supabase. Run against all vendors in a single directory_category; show ranked output with scores spread across the 0-100 range.
acceptance_criteria: VendorIntelligence has feature_depth_score (int | None) and feature_signals (list[str]) fields
admin_api.py _SCALAR_FIELDS includes feature_depth_score; feature_signals in list fields
Supabase cs_vendors table has feature_depth_score (int) and feature_signals (text[]) columns
csp-feature-depth-enrichment n8n workflow deployed to n8n cloud
Workflow crawls help_center_url, falls back to developer_docs_url, then website/help
LLM extraction covers 6 taxonomy dimensions: integrations, automation, reporting, onboarding, collaboration, API/developer
Scoring is category-relative: rank vendors within same directory_category, map to 0-100
feature_signals list contains detected capabilities as plain-English strings (max 20 per vendor)
Vendors with no accessible help content score null, not 0
Public directory browse page shows feature_depth_score as a sortable column
milestones.notes: This produces a first-party signal unique to SuccessByCS — not available anywhere else. More actionable for CS buyers than G2 star rating: tells you whether a vendor has 47 documented integration articles or 3. Scoring algorithm: (1) crawl help site, collect article titles + snippets; (2) LLM maps content to taxonomy dimensions; (3) raw dimension scores (0-10 each) summed; (4) percentile-rank within category -> 0-100 integer. Requires help_center_url to be populated first (M60 prerequisite). See docs/decisions/enrichment_data_sources.md Decision 3 for full rationale.
